label: fix 1: compete
result:
I fixed all 15 skeptic failures in `/Users/workingmyassof/satbank/spec/v2-upgrades/compete.md`. When I started, the file had no uncommitted changes, so no earlier fixer had touched it. Every change in the diff is mine, and nothing is committed.

- **Scorecard:** updated rows 2, 3, 5, 6, 8, 9, 15, 17, 21, 22, 23, 24, 30 and 33. Row 6 (their prize contests) and row 21 (period control) were "Unchanged" and are now WAY BETTER through C27. Row 30 now marks classes out of scope under decision 5.
- **C4:** "Your last week" shows only when the student's exam date is the season's SAT date. Otherwise a "Final focus" block shows, which still feeds `next.stage`. The doors line is now fixed: "Doors open by 7:45 AM; check your admission ticket."
- **C7:** every entrant's ladder shows each slot's skill (never the template). The warm-up uses the same rule, so the lobby and warm-up no longer contradict each other.
- **C10:** the Overview board card keeps the top 5, then a separator, then you ± 2.
- **C11:** "Contest rating" and "Skill rating (all practice)" are labelled apart everywhere and never drawn as parts of each other. Skill rating is its own Leaderboard metric with the Domain select; Contest rating's Domain select is disabled.
- **C12:** added `compete.trap_families()`. `slip` is never a theme, and there is a fallback when fewer than 5 families qualify. `s8.py --traps` checks 12 weeks.
- **C13:** each question type gets its own starting rating inside a tier, so Rush has more than three steps. When a run passes the hardest item it shows "Top of the bank". Rush names item difficulty as L-codes ("L6"), never "Level".
- **C14:** the Word Sprint is rebuilt on W16's run and scoring (right − wrong ÷ 3) with W1 and W2 items, a 4:00 clock and a Traps line. §3.2 now overrides words.md's rejection and defines the two S9 functions. The 4:00 clock is my own choice, since SAT-form items read slower than W16's 60 s allows; it needs a look.
- **C15:**
  - New flags: the window out of focus for 5 s or more, and copying the question then leaving the window. The strict confirm twin uses the same flags.
  - The Season Final routes on answers as given, confirms module 1 at the module break, and shows "Route kept: decided before confirms".
  - Board rows get a Clean / Confirmed mark with a legend. I took this off the Rejected list.
- **C17:** a line on the lobby says where an extended sitting is placed. A one-time sheet confirms it, with a contest-only timing setting, and private contests rank extended sittings with everyone.
- **C18 and C19 (decision 5):** rewritten as invite-code private contests that can repeat as a series. Each series has its own board (points and Over par), a streak, nudges and a "Full house" badge. Rounds can be built from "my" or "our" open mistakes. The creator's owner results table, Assign a repair and all class elements are gone; every entrant who finishes gets the grid view with each question's top trap.
- **C23:** the Go links now come from S8's `compete.go_for` and S1's `achievements.FOLDED`, which cover the badges R25 folded into Shell's rules.
- **C24:** keys are now scoped by focus region, so they no longer clash with the review keys: `Shift+B`, `Shift+V`, `Shift+Y`, with board keys only while focus is in the board.
- **New C26:** twins that never collide. A slot is keyed on the whole question, and templates must pass a 3,000-seed variety check, so a slot never falls back to another template.
- **New C27:** closed weeks, months, seasons and years stay viewable with frozen final standings. A Champions card and hall list podiums, and a season podium earns a ring on the level badge and a title on Me.
- **§3.1:** updated entries 1, 11, 12, 14, 15, 16, 18, 19, 22, 23, 25–31, 33, 34, 36–39. Added entry 40, which deletes or rewrites every group, class and teacher line in the main plan's Compete section (all quotes checked against the plan). Added entry 41 for the twin rules.
- **§3.2:** R4 marked void. Added rows for R3, P11, two words.md changes and Me Boards. Updated §2.5, §2.7, §2.8, §2.9, R25 and R28.
- **Rejected list:** the class items are merged into one line saying decision 5 removes them, and "Squads" is rewritten against private series.
